sources.title: Git Basics 03 - Erste Schritte mit Git (Deutsch).webm

selection: Two German Git instructional recordings; separate follow-up selected after the GitHub course screen. Same-course recordings are not independent creators. selected from official Commons metadata before viewing or scoring these originals. Exploratory follow-up; no representative recall.
rule: For each original, prepare 12 seconds at floor(min(duration-12,600)*q) for q=.10,.25,.35,.50,.65,.75,.90. This covers distinct points in the app-supported first ten minutes, avoiding duplicated capped timestamps on long recordings. Retain all 14 outcomes. Never add a defect. Inspect proposals for teaching meaning before independent HTTP export qualification.
phase: Frozen v10 baseline; later source-driven fixes are development, not held-out validation.
